title: On Infering the date from the handwriting
subtitle: 文学写作 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）
meta: 主题语境：文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）　|　核心词汇：infer　|　正文 351 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 infer 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1988 the gardener ① infered the date from the handwriting year after year, and every apprentice in the garden said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three springs on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the gardener ② infers the date from the handwriting for the whole place without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ infer the date from the handwriting at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ infered the date from the handwriting before — a line in the notebook for April 1982 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Infering the date from the handwriting year after year, the gardener said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the trowel at the far bed, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ infer his purpose from one line for the whole place, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Infer his purpose from one line at once and never mention it again.

By 1995 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the notebook, and a new apprentice from the next garden ⑧ infers his purpose from one line year after year every spring without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the bed, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ infered the date from the handwriting again when nobody else would.

⑩ To infer the date from the handwriting, my mother said in 2000, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the garden remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the garden forgets, somebody infers the date from the handwriting for the whole place again and somebody must infer the date from the handwriting year after year all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 推断（一般过去式 infered the date from the handwriting：1988 年园丁头一回这样做，年年地）
B. v. 推断（一般现在 infers the date from the handwriting：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 推断（不定式 to infer the date from the handwriting：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 推断（过去完成时 had infered the date from the handwriting：1982 年四月的园艺笔记上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 推断（动名词 infering the date from the handwriting 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 揣测（infer his purpose from one line：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去揣测从一行字里揣测他的用意）
G. v. 揣测（infer his purpose from one line：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 推断（后段两处：新来的学徒照例 infers his purpose from one line，而母亲又一次 infered the date from the handwriting）

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 infer 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1988 the gardener infered the date from the handwriting year after year, and nobody in the garden forgot it.
Even now the gardener infers the date from the handwriting for the whole place whenever the garden asks.
Infering the date from the handwriting year after year, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever infer his purpose from one line for the whole place, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new apprentice from the next garden infers his purpose from one line year after year every spring, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother infered the date from the handwriting again, and the garden remembered that half.
